name: Lingoes.ai
description: Lingoes.ai is an advanced AI-powered language processing tool designed to assist users in translating, understanding, and generating text across multiple languages. It leverages cutting-edge artificial intelligence to provide accurate translations, language learning support, and text analysis, making it an essential tool for both personal and professional use.

events.n: Classify Text With LingoesAI Ready Model
events.d: Ready multilingual and multi-domain NLP model for classifying your texts with class labels defined by you. Can be used for multiple different classification use cases like sentiment analysis, category identification…
